column1: # Hand-ruled fixes for print errors in the ABP Lexical Concordance's reference lines.
# Read by scripts/parse_abp_concordance.py. One row per printed (joined) line; the parser applies
# ONLY these — a line that fails and is not here is reported as a failure, never guessed.
# raw = the line exactly as the parser sees it (wrapped lines already joined; – = the PDF's dash).
# mapped = the line to parse instead. kind: typo | footnote. basis = why; every mapped verse was
# checked against abp_texts 2026-10-25 (diagnosis grade) — the number is present, stars = 2+.
# footnote rows: the book marks the word as in that verse's FOOTNOTE (ftnt / ft.); abp_texts has
# no such word in the verse text, so the diff reports them apart, never as a disagreement.
